meta.name: skill-vetter
meta.description: Security-first skill vetting for AI agents. Use before installing any skill from ClawdHub, GitHub, or other sources. Checks for red flags, permission scope, and suspicious patterns.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 安装前检查技能包的安全风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常从第三方来源安装AI技能，想先确认是否安全。
copy.tagline_en: Check skill packages for security risks before installing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often install AI skills from third-party sources and want to verify safety first.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在你安装任何技能前自动检查其安全性，包括来源、代码中的危险模式、所需权限，并给出风险等级和安装建议。
howto.when: 当你要求安装来自 ClawdHub、GitHub 等来源的技能时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这个技能是否安全。
say.note: Claude 会执行完整的审查流程并输出报告。

say.text: 检查这个 GitHub 仓库的技能文件。
say.note: Claude 会拉取仓库内容并分析风险。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will automatically vet any skill before installation, checking its source, code for red flags, required permissions, and output a risk level and install recommendation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to install a skill from ClawdHub, GitHub, or other sources.

say_en.text: Vet this skill for security issues.
say_en.note: Claude will run the full vetting protocol and produce a report.

say_en.text: Check the skill files in this GitHub repo.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch the repo contents and analyze risks.
